description: Land Acquisition - Dehikinda, Pasbagekorala D/S Division Kandy District.
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that a particular land parcel is required for public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed land descriptions, boundaries, location details, and survey information, which squarely fits the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related matters.
